svg.title: Unregularized overfitting vs L2 weight decay and validation checkpoint gate
svg.desc: Architecture delta comparing an unregularized training pipeline that memorizes noisy features (Val MSE 9.97) against a regularized pipeline with L2 Weight Decay and a Validation Gate reducing validation error 4.47x (Val MSE 2.23) and held-out test error 3.40x (Test MSE 9.98 to 2.93).
svg.text: Penalize spurious weight norm and gate checkpoints on unseen data
After · L2 Weight Decay + Val Gate
CHANGED · objectiveAdd L2 penalty 0.5 * wd * sum(w^2) (wd=0.35)
REMOVED · memorizeSuppress spurious weights on 24 noisy columns
ADDED · valgateGate checkpoint via jnp.where(val < best)
CHANGED · weightsShrink ||w||2 to 0.70; Test MSE 3.40x lower
REWIRED · r2Route regularized updates into Validation Gate
REMOVED · r3Eliminate blind final-step weight export
Incident split · Unseen validation evaluation · r1 · r5
